title: Democratic socialist Melat Kiros poised to become the first Gen Z woman in Congress
description: Kiros, a political newcomer, topped 15-term-incumbent Diana DeGette in the Democratic primary in Colorado's 1st Congressional District, a reliably blue House seat.

title: The 2026 FIFA World Cup schedule and how to watch
description: With 104 World Cup games being played in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, it's like "a Super Bowl every single day for five weeks," U.S. team captain Tim Ream told CBS News.

title: Phil Weiser projected to win Democratic primary for Colorado governor
description: Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser is the winner in the pivotal race to be the Democratic nominee for governor in Colorado, AP projects.

title: Democratic socialist Melat Kiros topples a nearly 30-year incumbent to win Colorado House primary
description: The 29-year-old DSA-backed challenger ousted Rep. Diana DeGette, one of Colorado’s longest-serving Democrats, in the primary for the 1st District.

title: Socialism goes west as DSA-backed challenger ousts longtime Democrat
description: Rep. Diana DeGette is defeated by a DSA-backed socialist challenger Melat Kiros in Colorado's Democratic primary, scoring a victory for the far-left's momentum.
